stem: The author includes the ideas in paragraphs 3 and 4 primarily to —

options.label: A
options.text: explain why visitors to zoos often experience troubling emotions

options.label: B
options.text: describe the zoo habitats of the animals that children most like to visit

options.label: C
options.text: advocate for zoo programs that will provide more-stimulating activities for the animals

options.label: D
options.text: inform visitors to zoos how to behave when viewing the animals
